name: DC Hub MCP
description: DC Hub is the live data layer for data-center site selection. Its Data Center Power Index (DCPI) is a daily score of where data centers can get grid power, across 300+ markets. Read tools keep Guard's usual handling. Tools that create or recover a key, save to an account, send email or webhooks, accept terms, request an introduction or file a report are gated on review. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Start keyless with the read tools search, rank_markets and analyze_site; they only read DC Hub data. execute_plan stays on Review because it runs a multi-step plan of other DC Hub tools server-side in one call, so Guard cannot gate each step.
Keep claim_free_key, bind_email and recover_my_key on Review: they create, bind or email a key for your user.
Keep save_site, save_to_shortlist and the set_*_alert, subscribe_digest and research_task tools on Review: they write to an account or start email.

register_standing_intent webhook kinds (new_deal_in_market, news_keyword, permitting_change) POST signed webhooks to a URL you give, so confirm the destination URL during review. delete_standing_intent is permanent.

register_standing_intent with kind="capacity" files a standing Capacity Source requirement that DC Hub follows up by email, so confirm the requirement, the contact details and that your user accepts the capacity terms.
Keep read_inbox on Review: it marks partner notes as read on first call, so a second session sees none.
accept_capacity_terms and request_capacity_intro accept terms or contact a capacity provider for your user; only run them after your user agrees.
